    People also ask
    What is the meaning of aviator?
    AI Overview

    AI Mode replied:

    aviator
    /ˈeɪvieɪtə/
    An aviator is an operator or pilot of an aircraft, such as an airplane, helicopter, or airship. The term can also refer to aviator sunglasses, a classic teardrop-shaped style of tinted eyewear originally designed for pilots in the 1930s. 
    Meaning & Contexts
    • Aircraft Pilot: According to the Merriam-Webster Dictionary, it primarily means someone who flies or operates an airplane. It is often considered a slightly formal, literary, or historical word compared to the modern term "pilot".
    • Military & History: It frequently evokes early 20th-century aviation pioneers (like Amelia Earhart or Charles Lindbergh) or military flyers.
    • Fashion: In plural form ("aviators"), it refers to teardrop-shaped metal-framed sunglasses with dark lenses
      .
       
    Common Synonyms
    • Pilot
    • Flyer / Flier
    • Airman or Aviatrix (female)
    • Aeronaut
